source: ACGME Common Program Requirements — Core Competencies

competencies.name: Patient Care
competencies.description: Compassionate, appropriate, and effective treatment and health promotion.

competencies.name: Medical Knowledge
competencies.description: Established and evolving biomedical and clinical sciences applied to patient care.

competencies.name: Practice-Based Learning and Improvement
competencies.description: Investigation and evaluation of practice, appraisal of evidence, and improvement.

competencies.name: Interpersonal and Communication Skills
competencies.description: Effective information exchange and collaboration with patients, families, and teams.

competencies.name: Professionalism
competencies.description: Commitment to professional responsibilities and ethical principles.

competencies.name: Systems-Based Practice
competencies.description: Effective work in health care systems for safe, equitable, high-quality care.
